title: What Is Lua Used For?
subtopics: Game scripting, automation, configuration, and application extensions
Standalone programs versus scripts embedded in other software
learning_outcomes: Explain the purpose of what Is Lua Used For? and the key behavior described in this lesson.
Apply what Is Lua Used For? in a small Lua example and predict its result.
Identify a relevant edge case, version constraint, or host-runtime limitation for what Is Lua Used For?.

content.intro: Lua is a compact, dynamically typed language designed to be embedded in host applications as well as run by its interpreter. Its small core makes it useful for extending software, but a host may expose only a selected set of APIs.
content.why_it_matters: Lua is a compact, dynamically typed language designed to be embedded in host applications as well as run by its interpreter. items.title: Mistake 1
items.text: Confusing What Is Lua Used For? with a similarly named feature in another language or runtime. Fix: follow the version-matched reference and test the smallest example.

items.title: Mistake 2
items.text: Relying on an output order or environment capability that the language/host does not guarantee. Fix: document assumptions and make order/capabilities explicit.

items.title: Mistake 3
items.text: Skipping a boundary test or failing to check error-return values. Fix: test invalid and boundary inputs and inspect failure values.
